text: Following BWSA and BWGI's crossing (via the Kaon E and Kaon V funds) of the 18% threshold of the Company's share capital on February 6, 2026, in accordance with the terms of the investment agreement between the Company and BWGI, the Supervisory Board, at the request of BWGI, appointed Juan Gomez as censor with effect from March 10, 2026, for a term of four years. [#929](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-929)

On October 9, 2023, the Company and BWGI (BWGI - manager of the Kaon E fund in particular) entered into an investment agreement, in the context of its acquisition of the entire equity investment of Predica (Crdit Agricole group) and its breach of the 5% threshold of the Company's share capital on October 11, 2023. [#6726](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6726)

CPPIB declared to the AMF on February 12, 2026 that it had fallen below the threshold of 10% of the Company's share capital (reference no. 226C0180) Wellington Management Group LLP declared to the AMF on February 13, 2026 that it had exceeded the threshold of 5% of the Company's share capital (reference no. 226C0192) CPPIB declared to the AMF on February 17, 2026 that it had fallen below the threshold of 10% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C0202) BWSA declared to the AMF on February 23, 2026 that it had risen below the threshold of 20% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C0217) [#6708](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6708)

[#6707](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6707)

Share capital and share ownership Shareholder agreement On June 7, 2017 the Company and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board ("CPP Investments") entered into an investment agreement (the "Investment Agreement") related to the investment made by CPP Investments as part of the Berendsen acquisition. [#6716](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6716)

At its meeting on October 26, 2023, the Supervisory Board had appointed Alexis Martineau as censor, representing BWGI, manager of the Kaon E fund, a new major shareholder in the Company that crossed the threshold of 5% of the share capital in 2023. [#926](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-926)

As regards governance, this investment agreement provides that BWGI has the right to nominate a representative to the Company's Supervisory Board if its shareholding in the Company is at least equal to 5%, and to nominate a second representative to the Company's Supervisory Board if its shareholding in the Company is at least equal to 15%. [#6730](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6730)

In addition, since the Kaon E and Kaon V funds (both sub-funds of the Kaon Investment Fund ICAV, which is itself managed by BWGI) have held more than 18% of the Company's share capital since February 6, 2026, in accordance with the terms of the investment agreement between the Company and BWGI, Juan Gomez was appointed as censor (with no voting rights) on March 10, 2026, at the request of BWGI. [#6734](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6734)

In the first half of 2026: BWSA disclosed to the AMF that:  on February 23, 2026, it exceeded the threshold of 20% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C0217),  on March 17, 2026, it fell below the threshold of 20% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C0339),  on June 18, 2026, it exceeded the threshold of 20% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C0862); CPPIB disclosed to the AMF that:  on February 12, 2026, it fell below the threshold of 10% of the Company's capital (reference no. 226C0180),  on February 17, 2026, it fell below the threshold of 10% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C0202); Wellington Management Group LLP disclosed to the AMF that:  on January 22, 2026, it fell below the threshold of 5% of the Company's capital (reference no. 226C0090),  on February 13, 2026, it exceeded the threshold of 5% of the Company's capital (reference no. 226C0192),  on March 9, 2026, it fell below the threshold of 5% of the Company's capital (reference no. 226C0279); Invesco Ltd disclosed to the AMF on March 17, 2026 that it exceeded the threshold of 5% of the Company's capital (reference no. 226C0340). [#166](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264346860-166)
No other crossing of the 5% capital threshold was reported to the AMF. [#168](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264346860-168)

After June 30, 2026: Invesco Ltd disclosed to the AMF on July 16, 2026 that it exceeded the threshold of 10% of the Company's capital (reference no. 226C1075), then on July 17, 2026, that it exceeded to the threshold of 10% of the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C1095); CPPIB disclosed to the AMF on July 21, 2026, that it fell below the threshold of 5% of the Company's capital and the Company's voting rights (reference no. 226C1111). [#167](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264346860-167)
